dialogues.jp: 「ううん……」
dialogues.en: "Uuungghh..."
dialogues.text: "Uuungghh..."

dialogues.jp:
眠い……やっぱ、こんな早い時間にセットする
んじゃなかった……。
dialogues.en: Sleepy... I couldn't have set the alarm this early..
dialogues.text: Sleepy... I couldn't have set the alarm this early..

dialogues.jp:
ぼんやりと目を開けて、目覚ましのスイッチを
押す。
dialogues.en:
I opened my eyes into slits, and searched for the snooze
button on the alarm clock.
dialogues.text:
I opened my eyes into slits, and searched for the snooze
button on the alarm clock.

dialogues.jp: 起きようかどうか迷いながら、寝返りをうつ。
dialogues.en:
I hit the snooze button, then turn over and try to sleep
again.
dialogues.text:
I hit the snooze button, then turn over and try to sleep
again.

dialogues.jp: 横を向いた俺の目の前に、人間の顔があった。
dialogues.en: Beside me and right in front of my eyes, I saw a face.
dialogues.text: Beside me and right in front of my eyes, I saw a face.

dialogues.jp: 「ぬおっ！？」
dialogues.en: "Mwah!?"
dialogues.text: "Mwah!?"

dialogues.jp: 慌てて飛び起きる。
dialogues.en:
My drowziness wore off in an instant as I jumped up in
horror.
dialogues.text:
My drowziness wore off in an instant as I jumped up in
horror.

dialogues.jp:
めくれた布団の上で、さくらがパジャマ姿をさ
らしていた。
dialogues.en: Lying on my futon was Sakura, clad only in her pajamas.
dialogues.text: Lying on my futon was Sakura, clad only in her pajamas.

dialogues.jp: 「なんでさくらが隣で寝てるんだ！？」
dialogues.en: "Why is Sakura sleeping beside me!?"
dialogues.text: "Why is Sakura sleeping beside me!?"

dialogues.jp: 頭をおさえ、昨晩のことを思い返す。
dialogues.en:
I try to calm myself down, and recall the events of the
night before.
dialogues.text:
I try to calm myself down, and recall the events of the
night before.

dialogues.jp: 俺が寝たときには確かにいなかった。
dialogues.en: I don't remember anything about this before I fell asleep.
dialogues.text: I don't remember anything about this before I fell asleep.

dialogues.jp: （また、窓から不法侵入？）
dialogues.en:
"(Don't tell me, another unauthorized intrusion from the
window?)"
dialogues.text:
"(Don't tell me, another unauthorized intrusion from the
window?)"

dialogues.jp:
とにかく、こんなところを音夢に見られたらマ
ズイ。
dialogues.en: Whatever the case, I can't let Nemu see this.
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, I can't let Nemu see this.

dialogues.jp: 「おいっ、起きろさくら！」
dialogues.en: "Oy, Sakura, wake up!"
dialogues.text: "Oy, Sakura, wake up!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「むにゃぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Munyah..."
dialogues.text: "Munyah..."

dialogues.jp: さくらは眠ったまま、変な声をだしている。
dialogues.en: Sakura was still half-asleep, and replied in a dreamy voice.
dialogues.text: Sakura was still half-asleep, and replied in a dreamy voice.

dialogues.jp:
「ほらっ、とっとと起きろっ。早くしないと窓
　から放り投げるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Come on, hurry up and wake up! Go back out through the
window again!"
dialogues.text:
"Come on, hurry up and wake up! Go back out through the
window again!"

dialogues.jp:
無理矢理、さくらの上半身を起こして、肩をゆ
する。
dialogues.en:
I forcefully sit her up, and shake her shoulders
vigourously.
dialogues.text:
I forcefully sit her up, and shake her shoulders
vigourously.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ふみゃぁ〜」
dialogues.en: "Fumiya~"
dialogues.text: "Fumiya~"

dialogues.jp: さくらが、ようやく重い｛まぶた／瞼｝をあける。
dialogues.en: Sakura finally opened her massive eyelids.
dialogues.text: Sakura finally opened her massive eyelids.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう……お兄ちゃん……」
dialogues.en: "'Morning... onii-chan..."
dialogues.text: "'Morning... onii-chan..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「当たりまえのように挨拶するなっ。なんでお
　前がここで寝てるんだ」
dialogues.en: "Don't just greet me normally! Why're you sleeping here?"
dialogues.text: "Don't just greet me normally! Why're you sleeping here?"

dialogues.jp: まだ寝ぼけ顔のさくらのおでこを小突く。
dialogues.en: I poke Sakura's sleepy face in the forehead.
dialogues.text: I poke Sakura's sleepy face in the forehead.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにをする、兄じゃ！」
dialogues.en: "Stop that, nii-ja!"
dialogues.text: "Stop that, nii-ja!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「兄じゃ、じゃない！！」
dialogues.en: "I'm not your "nii-ja"!"
dialogues.text: "I'm not your "nii-ja"!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、寝ぼけてないでさっさと窓から枝伝っ
　て帰れ。音夢に見つかったら俺が殺されるだ
　ろうが」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, wake up already and go back to your house through
the window! If Nemu sees this, she'd kill me!"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, wake up already and go back to your house through
the window! If Nemu sees this, she'd kill me!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「その方がいいんだけどな」
dialogues.en: "What's so bad about that."
dialogues.text: "What's so bad about that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp:
さくらの顔に目を遣ると、いつもの笑顔があっ
た。
dialogues.en: I turn to face Sakura, and see her usual grin.
dialogues.text: I turn to face Sakura, and see her usual grin.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃあね、お兄ちゃん。ボクがいたこと
　は音夢ちゃんにはしーだよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Then I'd leave now. If I'm around, Nemu will be maaad
right?"
dialogues.text:
"Then I'd leave now. If I'm around, Nemu will be maaad
right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だれが言うか。いいからとっとと行け」
dialogues.en: "That's why I said, hurry up and go!"
dialogues.text: "That's why I said, hurry up and go!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ、じゃあね〜」
dialogues.en: "Nyah, see you!"
dialogues.text: "Nyah, see you!"

dialogues.jp:
器用に窓から外に出ると、桜の枝で一度こちら
を振り返って、ニッコリと手をふる。
dialogues.en:
She lightly jumped out the window, and standing on the
branch, turned back and gave a little wave before
disappearing out of sight.
dialogues.text:
She lightly jumped out the window, and standing on the
branch, turned back and gave a little wave before
disappearing out of sight.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……びっくりした」
dialogues.en: "Haah... that was scary."
dialogues.text: "Haah... that was scary."

dialogues.jp:
胸に手を当てて髪をかきあげて、俺は顔を洗い
に洗面所に向かった。
dialogues.en:
With one hand on my chest and one in my hair, I head to the
bathroom to wash my face.
dialogues.text:
With one hand on my chest and one in my hair, I head to the
bathroom to wash my face.

dialogues.jp: ◆目覚めるとそこにさくらが◆
dialogues.en: ◆Awakening Next to Sakura◆
dialogues.text: ◆Awakening Next to Sakura◆

dialogues.jp:
目覚ましのベルに起こされると、何故か、隣に
さくらが居た。一体、何をしに来たのやら……。
dialogues.en:
Waken up by the alarm, somehow, Sakura was sleeping beside
me. Just why did she come here now...
dialogues.text:
Waken up by the alarm, somehow, Sakura was sleeping beside
me. Just why did she come here now...

dialogues.jp: 急いで起こし、部屋から追い出す俺だった。
dialogues.en: I quickly woke her up, and chased her out of my room.
dialogues.text: I quickly woke her up, and chased her out of my room.
